name: 97540 · Talent, OR
findings: ZIP 97540 (Talent) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97540 (Talent) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 97540 (Talent) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).
